# This file is GENERATED from uv.lock, which stays the source of truth, together
# with pyproject.toml. Regenerate it after changing dependencies with:
#
#     uv export --format requirements-txt --no-hashes --no-emit-project -o requirements.txt
#
# Install into a fresh virtual environment:
#
#     python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
#     pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Run the backend from the REPOSITORY ROOT (`backend.config` resolves .env from
# the current working directory, and `backend.*` only imports from here):
#
#     uvicorn backend.api.src.main:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
#
# Python 3.11+ is required; version-specific pins carry environment markers.

#   * reranking        — `uv sync --extra rerank`   (torch, ~2 GB)

#   * localGPT stack   — `uv sync --extra localgpt`

# a PyPI package; retrieval degrades visibly to the in-repo lexical backend when
# it is absent.

# pnpm-lock.yaml (`pnpm install`), not from this file.
